title: WSDL Binding
description: Schema describing a binding element in a WSDL 2.0 document. A binding specifies concrete message format and transmission protocol details for operations defined by an interface.

name.description: The local name of the binding, unique within the WSDL target namespace.

interface.description: A qualified name referencing the interface to which this binding applies.

type.description: A URI identifying the binding type (e.g., http://www.w3.org/ns/wsdl/soap for SOAP binding).

ref.description: A qualified name referencing the interface operation this binding operation corresponds to.

soapAction.description: The SOAP action URI for this operation when using a SOAP binding.

soapMep.description: The SOAP message exchange pattern URI for this operation.

httpMethod.description: The HTTP method used for this operation when using an HTTP binding.

httpLocation.description: The HTTP location template for this operation when using an HTTP binding.

operation.description: A list of binding operation definitions mapping interface operations to concrete protocol details.

ref.description: A qualified name referencing the interface fault this binding fault corresponds to.

soapCode.description: The SOAP fault code for this binding fault.

fault.description: A list of binding fault definitions mapping interface faults to concrete protocol details.
